name: Young Girl
source:
A black-haired girl tasked with helping guard Hao-Chen. She appears to be no older than 14-15 years old. Always quiet with her head hung low, she keeps a watchful eye on Hao-Chen and avoids any questions she doesn't want to answer. She feels unease about her actions, but follows the directions of the mysterious girl. Their relationship in itself is also a mystery.

[spoiler]Her full name is later revealed in the story to be Huang I-ling and she is the blood-related younger sister of the mysterious girl.[/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/013/790/3312344931ee3108f97a806211417db9_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1517260451&auto=format&lossless=true&s=c62951f57e4f6b54313a6684d5638342]Kickstarter Description[/url]]
